import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

for match in re.finditer(r'\b(a|b|TMP)\s*<-\s*(a|b|TMP|\d+)\b', text):
    target, source = match.groups()
    values[target] = values[source] if source in ("a", "b", "TMP") else int(source)

print(f"a ?= {values['a']}; b ?= {values['b']}; TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
